title.en: Your engine can brake your car by itself #shorts

description.en: Engine braking: why lifting off the throttle slows a petrol car.
description.id: Engine brake: kenapa melepas gas memperlambat mobil bensin.

scenes.en: Lift your foot off the gas and your car starts *braking* by itself.
scenes.id: Angkat kakimu dari gas dan mobilmu mulai *mengerem* sendiri.

scenes.en: Your wheels are still turning the engine, through the *gearbox*.
But the *throttle* is now almost closed, so air barely gets in.
scenes.id: Tapi *throttle* hampir tertutup, jadi udara hampir tidak bisa masuk ke mesin.

scenes.en: Each piston must pull against that *vacuum* on its way down.
scenes.id: Tiap piston harus menarik melawan *vakum* itu saat turun.

scenes.en: Pulling against a vacuum takes *work*, and that work comes from your wheels.
scenes.id: Menarik melawan vakum butuh *tenaga*, dan tenaga itu diambil dari rodamu.

scenes.en: A lower gear spins the engine faster, so it brakes *harder*.
scenes.id: Gigi lebih rendah memutar mesin lebih cepat, jadi remnya *lebih kuat*.

scenes.en: Free braking, no brake pads. Send this to a downhill driver.
scenes.id: Rem gratis, tanpa kampas rem. Kirim ini ke temanmu yang sering lewat turunan.
